LORESTUDIO.enabled: Send to Lore Studio from this browser
LORESTUDIO.enabledHint: Turn this on in one GM browser only (for example the spectator view on the PC that runs Lore Studio).
LORESTUDIO.urlHint: Shown in Lore Studio under Settings → Foundry. Usually http://127.0.0.1:42012
LORESTUDIO.tokenHint: Copy it from Lore Studio under Settings → Foundry.
LORESTUDIO.sceneryFitHint: Scenes in the scenery folder are sized to 1920×1080, and their backgrounds fill the screen with the edges cropped. Your image files aren't changed.
LORESTUDIO.sceneryFolderHint: Name of the scene folder to fit to 1920×1080 (subfolders count too).
LORESTUDIO.sceneryDayNight: Change backgrounds with the time of day
LORESTUDIO.sceneryDayNightHint: Name a scene's images like canyon_dawn.webp, canyon_day.webp, canyon_dusk.webp and canyon_night.webp, in the same folder, and set the scene to any one of them. Missing versions are skipped. Follows Calendaria's sunrise and sunset if it's installed.
LORESTUDIO.sceneryFadeHint: How long the old background takes to fade into the new one. 0 switches instantly.
